summary: PHP's third RCE will get no emergency fix as Mirai joins PHP2Shell attacks, while LiteLLM's compromise is traced back eleven days to its GitHub breach; HPE patched 72 ArubaOS flaws, APT41 revived a Secure Boot-defeating bootkit, and Quest Diagnostics disclosed a patient-records breach alongside Tor, Popcorn Time, Postiz, edge-harvesting, GMO extortion, Collabora KEV, Brotli, Fortinet, rogue AI agent, and Meta GhostShares developments.
